scripts.upgrade: curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o download-worker.sh.new https://github.com/sagikazarmark/atuin-worker/releases/latest/download/download-worker.sh && sh download-worker.sh.new && mv download-worker.sh.new download-worker.sh
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ATUIN_USERNAME.description: The name you log in with: `atuin login -u <username>`. Letters, digits and hyphens only.

ATUIN_PASSWORD.description: At least 16 characters. Generate it, for example with `openssl rand -base64 24`, and do not use it anywhere else.

DB.description: Stores your encrypted Atuin records. D1 keeps it in one region, near where it is created.

PAGE_SIZE.description: Records per upload and download page. **PAGE_SIZE × MAX_RECORD_SIZE** must not exceed 40 MiB.

MAX_RECORD_SIZE.description: Largest accepted record payload in bytes. Real records are a few KB.
